messages:
Hannah Cole: Quick follow-up from the DB-pool exhaustion postmortem. Consolidating action items here so we can assign owners and tickets. Aim: owners + Jiras by EOD Wed.

Hannah Cole: Actions we captured: 1) Add pool-size autoscaling + safe caps per service. 2) Add diagnostic traces for connection acquire latency. 3) Update runbook with emergency connection-evict steps and health-check tweaks. 4) Backfill queries for last quarter to find repeat offenders. 5) Create RACI and rotation for DB incidents.

Vikram Desai: I'll own #2 (connection acquire traces). Will add a short span in the client lib and a Grafana panel. ETA: 7 days.

Vikram Desai: Jira: INFRA-7682 "conn-acquire-tracing + dashboard". Leaving PRD link in the ticket.

Olivia Park: I'll take #1 (pool autoscaling). Need to coordinate with DB team on safe caps per shard. @Ben Wallace can you help with shard sizing?

Olivia Park: Created ticket: SRE-6910 "db-client: pool autoscale + caps". Drafting proposal for per-service caps.

Ben Wallace: Happy to help on shard sizing. Also will add a knob to prevent aggressive downsizing during ramp windows.

Ben Wallace: Subtask created: SRE-6910-1 "downsize safety guard". ETA: Thu.

Hannah Cole: For #3 runbook, I can draft emergency evict steps and safe restart order. Need someone from oncall to review. @Vikram do you have time?

Vikram Desai: I can review. Suggest adding a short diagnostic command block and the exact sequence to drain connections.

Olivia Park: For #4 (backfill queries) I can run initial scans but need read access to archival logs. @RemediateBot can you schedule an export job?

RemediateBot: Scheduled: export DB conn logs Apr-Jun to analytics-bucket (job 2359879900). Reminder set for owner check-in in 48 hours (2359884300).

Ben Wallace: One more ask: add an automatic incident tag when conn-acquire latency > 200ms for >5min so we can track recurrence. I'll open a small tooling ticket.

Ben Wallace: Ticket: TOOLS-1322 "incident tag: db-acquire-latency". ETA: Fri.

Hannah Cole: RACI suggestion: Responsible = oncall, Accountable = infra-sre lead, Consulted = db team, Informed = product + SRE. Rotation: 2-week oncall owner handover. Any objections?

Olivia Park: ACK on RACI and rotation. I'll add contact info in the runbook.

Vikram Desai: ACK. Also will ensure INFRA-7682 includes an example trace in the PR.

Ben Wallace: ACK. I'll add the downsize guard details to SRE-6910 and link TOOLS-1322.

Hannah Cole: Summary: owners assigned (INFRA-7682 Vikram, SRE-6910 Olivia, TOOLS-1322 Ben), export job scheduled, RACI agreed. I'll push these into the remediation tracker after tickets have due dates. Closing loop here unless blockers appear.

Olivia Park: I'll add due dates by tomorrow.

Vikram Desai: Will post trace snippet in INFRA-7682 this week.

RemediateBot: Reminder: follow-up owners check-in in 48 hours (2359884300).

Hannah Cole: Thanks all. Ping this thread if anything changes.
